title: ImportEventFromLinkCallablePayload
description: Command event.import-from-link (contracts/commands/catalog.json). A phone-verified caller with a try-it workspace sends one public event page or calendar (Luma, District, Urbanaut, or a page the generic reader can follow). The first preview with an idempotency key starts reading it and answers running; previewing again lists the upcoming events found, and with input.eventKey answers the private draft event apply would create in the workspace. Apply creates it.

link.description: One public event page or calendar.

eventKey.description: Which found event to draft, from result.events. Needed when the page lists more than one.
